question: What is a semiconductor?
urdu_translation: semiconductor کیا ہے؟
A: Perfect conductor at all temperatures / تمام temperatures پر perfect conductor
B: Material with conductivity between conductors and insulators / material جس کی conductivity conductors اور insulators کے between ہو
C: Perfect insulator with no electrons / no electrons والا perfect insulator
D: Magnetic material only / صرف magnetic material
correct_answer: B | Material with conductivity between conductors and insulators / material جس کی conductivity conductors اور insulators کے between ہو

question: Which elements are commonly used as intrinsic semiconductors?
urdu_translation: intrinsic semiconductors کے طور پر commonly کون سے elements use ہوتے ہیں؟
A: Copper and aluminium / copper اور aluminium
B: Hydrogen and oxygen / hydrogen اور oxygen
C: Iron and nickel / iron اور nickel
D: Silicon and germanium / silicon اور germanium
correct_answer: D | Silicon and germanium / silicon اور germanium

question: How does semiconductor conductivity generally change with temperature?
urdu_translation: semiconductor conductivity temperature کے ساتھ generally کیسے change ہوتی ہے؟
A: It always decreases / یہ ہمیشہ decrease ہوتی ہے
B: It increases as temperature rises / temperature rise کے ساتھ increase ہوتی ہے
C: It remains zero / یہ zero رہتی ہے
D: It is unrelated to temperature / temperature سے unrelated ہے
correct_answer: B | It increases as temperature rises / temperature rise کے ساتھ increase ہوتی ہے

question: What is doping?
urdu_translation: doping کیا ہے؟
A: Removing all atoms / تمام atoms remove کرنا
B: Adding a small amount of impurity to a pure semiconductor / pure semiconductor میں small impurity add کرنا
C: Heating a conductor to melting / conductor کو melting تک heat کرنا
D: Charging by friction / friction سے charging
correct_answer: B | Adding a small amount of impurity to a pure semiconductor / pure semiconductor میں small impurity add کرنا

question: Which charge carriers are majority in an N-type semiconductor?
urdu_translation: N-type semiconductor میں majority charge carriers کون سے ہیں؟
A: Holes / holes
B: Protons / protons
C: Neutrons / neutrons
D: Electrons / electrons
correct_answer: D | Electrons / electrons

question: Which charge carriers are majority in a P-type semiconductor?
urdu_translation: P-type semiconductor میں majority charge carriers کون سے ہیں؟
A: Electrons / electrons
B: Neutrons / neutrons
C: Photons / photons
D: Holes / holes
correct_answer: D | Holes / holes

question: Which type of impurity produces an N-type semiconductor?
urdu_translation: کون سی impurity N-type semiconductor produce کرتی ہے؟
A: Trivalent impurity / trivalent impurity
B: Noble gas only / صرف noble gas
C: No impurity / no impurity
D: Pentavalent impurity / pentavalent impurity
correct_answer: D | Pentavalent impurity / pentavalent impurity

question: Which type of impurity produces a P-type semiconductor?
urdu_translation: کون سی impurity P-type semiconductor produce کرتی ہے؟
A: Trivalent impurity / trivalent impurity
B: Pentavalent impurity / pentavalent impurity
C: Divalent metal only / صرف divalent metal
D: No impurity / no impurity
correct_answer: A | Trivalent impurity / trivalent impurity

question: What is formed when P-type and N-type materials are joined?
urdu_translation: P-type اور N-type materials join کرنے پر کیا form ہوتا ہے؟
A: Transformer core / transformer core
B: Electromagnet / electromagnet
C: PN junction / PN junction
D: Capacitor plate only / صرف capacitor plate
correct_answer: C | PN junction / PN junction

question: What is the depletion region?
urdu_translation: depletion region کیا ہے؟
A: Region near the junction depleted of mobile charge carriers / junction کے near mobile charge carriers سے depleted region
B: Region full of free carriers only / صرف free carriers سے full region
C: Metal contact outside the diode / diode کے outside metal contact
D: Region of sound waves / sound waves region
correct_answer: A | Region near the junction depleted of mobile charge carriers / junction کے near mobile charge carriers سے depleted region

question: What is the role of the barrier potential at a PN junction?
urdu_translation: PN junction پر barrier potential کا role کیا ہے؟
A: It creates unlimited current / یہ unlimited current create کرتا ہے
B: It opposes further diffusion of majority carriers / یہ majority carriers کی further diffusion oppose کرتا ہے
C: It removes the junction / یہ junction remove کرتا ہے
D: It converts DC into sound / یہ DC کو sound میں convert کرتا ہے
correct_answer: B | It opposes further diffusion of majority carriers / یہ majority carriers کی further diffusion oppose کرتا ہے

question: How is a diode forward biased?
urdu_translation: diode کو forward bias کیسے کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: P-side to positive and N-side to negative / P-side positive اور N-side negative سے
B: P-side to negative and N-side to positive / P-side negative اور N-side positive سے
C: Both sides to positive / دونوں sides positive سے
D: Both sides disconnected / دونوں sides disconnected
correct_answer: A | P-side to positive and N-side to negative / P-side positive اور N-side negative سے

question: What happens to the depletion layer in forward bias?
urdu_translation: forward bias میں depletion layer کے ساتھ کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: It becomes narrower / یہ narrower ہوتی ہے
B: It becomes wider / یہ wider ہوتی ہے
C: It becomes an insulator of infinite width / infinite width insulator بن جاتی ہے
D: It turns into a magnet / یہ magnet بن جاتی ہے
correct_answer: A | It becomes narrower / یہ narrower ہوتی ہے

question: How is a diode reverse biased?
urdu_translation: diode کو reverse bias کیسے کیا جاتا ہے؟
A: P-side to positive and N-side to negative / P-side positive اور N-side negative سے
B: Both sides earthed only / صرف دونوں sides earthed
C: No voltage applied with high current / no voltage with high current
D: P-side to negative and N-side to positive / P-side negative اور N-side positive سے
correct_answer: D | P-side to negative and N-side to positive / P-side negative اور N-side positive سے

question: What happens to the depletion layer in reverse bias?
urdu_translation: reverse bias میں depletion layer کے ساتھ کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: It becomes wider / یہ wider ہوتی ہے
B: It becomes narrower / یہ narrower ہوتی ہے
C: It disappears completely / یہ completely disappear ہوتی ہے
D: It emits sound / یہ sound emit کرتی ہے
correct_answer: A | It becomes wider / یہ wider ہوتی ہے

question: A semiconductor diode mainly allows current:
urdu_translation: semiconductor diode current کو mainly کیسے allow کرتی ہے؟
A: Equally in both directions / دونوں directions میں equally
B: Only through vacuum / صرف vacuum through
C: In one direction / one direction میں
D: Only when no voltage is applied / صرف no voltage پر
correct_answer: C | In one direction / one direction میں

question: Which statement describes the diode V-I characteristic?
urdu_translation: diode V-I characteristic کو کون سا statement describe کرتا ہے؟
A: Perfectly linear in both directions / دونوں directions میں perfectly linear
B: No current in forward bias at any voltage / any voltage پر forward bias میں no current
C: Small forward current below threshold, then rapid increase; tiny reverse current / threshold سے below small forward current، پھر rapid increase؛ tiny reverse current
D: Large reverse current at all voltages / تمام voltages پر large reverse current
correct_answer: C | Small forward current below threshold, then rapid increase; tiny reverse current / threshold سے below small forward current، پھر rapid increase؛ tiny reverse current

question: What is rectification?
urdu_translation: rectification کیا ہے؟
A: Conversion of DC into AC only / صرف DC کو AC میں conversion
B: Conversion of light into sound / light کو sound میں conversion
C: Heating a resistor / resistor heating
D: Conversion of AC into DC / AC کو DC میں conversion
correct_answer: D | Conversion of AC into DC / AC کو DC میں conversion

question: Why is a diode useful in a rectifier circuit?
urdu_translation: rectifier circuit میں diode useful کیوں ہے؟
A: It conducts during one half-cycle and blocks the opposite half-cycle / یہ one half-cycle میں conduct اور opposite half-cycle block کرتی ہے
B: It conducts equally in both directions / یہ دونوں directions میں equally conduct کرتی ہے
C: It stores all AC charge permanently / یہ تمام AC charge permanently store کرتی ہے
D: It produces a magnetic field without current / یہ current کے بغیر magnetic field produce کرتی ہے
correct_answer: A | It conducts during one half-cycle and blocks the opposite half-cycle / یہ one half-cycle میں conduct اور opposite half-cycle block کرتی ہے

question: What does LED stand for?
urdu_translation: LED کا full form کیا ہے؟
A: Low-energy detector / low-energy detector
B: Linear electric device / linear electric device
C: Light-emitting diode / light-emitting diode
D: Light electron divider / light electron divider
correct_answer: C | Light-emitting diode / light-emitting diode

question: When does an LED emit light?
urdu_translation: LED light کب emit کرتی ہے؟
A: Only when reverse biased strongly / صرف strong reverse bias پر
B: When forward biased and current flows / forward biased ہونے اور current flow پر
C: When disconnected / disconnected ہونے پر
D: When placed in vacuum without voltage / vacuum میں without voltage
correct_answer: B | When forward biased and current flows / forward biased ہونے اور current flow پر

question: Why is a series resistor often used with an LED?
urdu_translation: LED کے ساتھ series resistor often کیوں use ہوتا ہے؟
A: To increase current without limit / current unlimited increase کرنے کے لیے
B: To reverse the junction permanently / junction permanently reverse کرنے کے لیے
C: To limit current and protect the LED / current limit اور LED protect کرنے کے لیے
D: To make the LED an AC generator / LED کو AC generator بنانے کے لیے
correct_answer: C | To limit current and protect the LED / current limit اور LED protect کرنے کے لیے

question: What is an analogue signal?
urdu_translation: analogue signal کیا ہے؟
A: A signal with only two discrete levels / صرف two discrete levels والا signal
B: A signal with no variation / no variation signal
C: A continuously varying signal / continuously varying signal
D: A magnetic pole / magnetic pole
correct_answer: C | A continuously varying signal / continuously varying signal

question: What is a digital signal?
urdu_translation: digital signal کیا ہے؟
A: A continuously varying signal only / صرف continuously varying signal
B: A signal without information / information کے بغیر signal
C: A signal represented by discrete levels such as 0 and 1 / discrete levels جیسے 0 اور 1 سے represented signal
D: A sound wave only / صرف sound wave
correct_answer: C | A signal represented by discrete levels such as 0 and 1 / discrete levels جیسے 0 اور 1 سے represented signal

question: What does an analogue-to-digital converter do?
urdu_translation: analogue-to-digital converter کیا کرتا ہے؟
A: Converts an analogue signal into digital data / analogue signal کو digital data میں convert کرتا ہے
B: Converts digital data into heat / digital data کو heat میں convert کرتا ہے
C: Produces static charge / static charge produce کرتا ہے
D: Measures magnetic field only / صرف magnetic field measure کرتا ہے
correct_answer: A | Converts an analogue signal into digital data / analogue signal کو digital data میں convert کرتا ہے

question: What is sampling in analogue-to-digital conversion?
urdu_translation: analogue-to-digital conversion میں sampling کیا ہے؟
A: Increasing signal continuously / signal continuously increase کرنا
B: Removing all data / تمام data remove کرنا
C: Measuring the signal at regular time intervals / regular time intervals پر signal measure کرنا
D: Reflecting the signal / signal reflect کرنا
correct_answer: C | Measuring the signal at regular time intervals / regular time intervals پر signal measure کرنا

question: What is quantization?
urdu_translation: quantization کیا ہے؟
A: Taking samples at random only / صرف random samples لینا
B: Assigning sampled values to discrete levels / sampled values کو discrete levels assign کرنا
C: Changing binary into sound / binary کو sound میں change کرنا
D: Removing the clock signal / clock signal remove کرنا
correct_answer: B | Assigning sampled values to discrete levels / sampled values کو discrete levels assign کرنا

question: What is encoding in an ADC?
urdu_translation: ADC میں encoding کیا ہے؟
A: Converting binary to analogue before sampling / sampling سے پہلے binary کو analogue میں convert کرنا
B: Adding noise deliberately / deliberately noise add کرنا
C: Representing each quantized level as a binary number / each quantized level کو binary number سے represent کرنا
D: Generating magnetic flux / magnetic flux generate کرنا
correct_answer: C | Representing each quantized level as a binary number / each quantized level کو binary number سے represent کرنا

question: Which is an advantage of digital signals?
urdu_translation: digital signals کا advantage کون سا ہے؟
A: They can be stored and processed with greater noise resistance / وہ greater noise resistance کے ساتھ stored اور processed ہو سکتی ہیں
B: They always contain infinite precision / وہ ہمیشہ infinite precision رکھتی ہیں
C: They require no conversion from sensors / sensors سے no conversion require کرتی ہیں
D: They cannot be copied / وہ copy نہیں ہو سکتی
correct_answer: A | They can be stored and processed with greater noise resistance / وہ greater noise resistance کے ساتھ stored اور processed ہو سکتی ہیں

A: OR gate / OR gate
B: AND gate / AND gate
C: NOT gate / NOT gate
